title: Mathlib v4.30 source proposition Nat.clog_mono
statement: The proposition declared as `Nat.clog_mono` in the pinned Mathlib v4.30 source.

formal.statement: ∀ {b c m n : ℕ}, 1 < c → c ≤ b → m ≤ n → Nat.clog b m ≤ Nat.clog c n
